drivers.title: How drivers are delivered
paragraphs: The drivers for {bundled} come with the Mac app. No separate client software is needed to connect.
Other drivers download as signed plugins when you first select the database. The first download needs an internet connection.
TablePro checks each plugin’s SHA-256 checksum against the registry and verifies its code signature before installation.
Driver plugins update separately from the app. Updates to a driver in use take effect after you restart.
The iPhone and iPad app has built-in drivers; it does not download plugins.
